name: Set Actor Location
description: Moves an actor's root component to an absolute world-space position. Optionally sweeps against blocking geometry instead of teleporting. Returns true if the location was successfully set.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The actor whose root component should be moved. Connect a Get reference, a Spawn Actor output, or a self-reference.

inputs.name: New Location
inputs.description: The new world-space location for the actor's root component. Connect a Make Vector node or a Vector variable.

inputs.name: Sweep
inputs.description: Whether to sweep the actor to the destination, testing for blocking collision along the way. Disable for clean teleports.

inputs.name: Teleport
inputs.description: How to handle physics state for the teleport: None (preserve velocity) or TeleportPhysics (reset physics state).

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the location is applied. Continue the graph from here.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: True if the location was successfully set. False when sweeping is enabled and the move was blocked by collision.
